schedule: before 8am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Cooldown before we pick up a new release, so a compromised publish has time to be caught and unpublished. Mirrors `min-release-age` in frontend/.npmrc, which only covers a dependency added by hand.
Same cooldown for the backend. Matching the PyPI datasource covers the pep621 manager (pyproject.toml and uv.lock) and the uv pin kept by the custom manager below.

eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7.1 turns react-hooks/set-state-in-effect into an error and adds preserve-manual-memoization findings (1 error and 23 warnings today, mostly in frontend/src/pages/transactions.tsx), and `npm run lint -- --max-warnings=0` makes warnings fatal. Held below 7.1.0, with an exact pin in frontend/package.json, until those findings are fixed in a change of their own.
Postgres majors need a deliberate data migration for self-hosters — never auto-PR them

customManagers.description: uv pinned in the Dockerfile, CI and scripts/lock.sh (marked with a `# renovate:` comment)
